results.title: Your Ash & My Bone
results.overview: An artist’s memoir navigating the scars of his own past through the lens of Thailand’s fractured political history and surreal contemporary art. The film traces nearly four decades of growth—from a boy with a meaningless name to a young man awakening amidst the smoke and blood of history. It is a profound exploration of grief, intertwining personal loss with the death of an internal patriarch, the cost of freedom, and the lingering aesthetics of the soul.

results.title: UNTIL NEXT TIME
results.overview: After his fiancée's death, an emotionally unstable man is approached by a mysterious man who offers him a second chance to bring back what was lost at a deadly cost.

results.title: Grave Danger
results.overview: A grave robber is terrorized while looting corpses in a cemetery.

results.title: D3STRO
results.overview: A young couple shares a deep passion about food and desire for each other. They put all their efforts to satisfy all their fantasies, until they come with the ultimate culinary experience. One must be eaten and the second must feed from the other’s flesh.

results.title: A Thrift Story
results.overview: It’s Amy’s last day at the no-name thrift store where she works, but she’s got one last difficult customer to deal with.

results.title: Take His Life
results.overview: Beneath the glitter of London's finance world, a destitute man forces his way back from the streets into power. Over the course of a week, his hunger for success hardens into obsession, exposing a ruthless truth: in a system built on glass, survival demands taking another's life.

results.title: Mimic
results.overview: Amid the heightening ICE raids across Los Angeles, a Filipino Man visits his estranged sister’s home and makes a terrifying discovery.

results.title: Wherever the wind takes us
results.overview: Two balloons realises that they both want different things out of their short lives, but they don't want to do it without each other.

results.title: PASTIS
results.overview: Sasha, 20, returns to her family’s sun-soaked home in the south of France with her friends—her first visit since her older sister’s death. What begins as an idyllic summer escape slowly curdles into something far more suffocating.

results.title: Devil's Disciple: The Night Stalker
results.overview: A relentless, killer-POV descent into the mind of Richard Ramirez as he stalks 1980s Los Angeles, leaving terror, bloodshed, and belief-driven brutality in his wake.

results.title: L'inconvénient
results.overview: In a Quebec cotton mill in the early 1900s, when a teenage girl injures her hand on a machine, her elder sister works tirelessly to keep her from being fired.

results.title: Run Koala Run
results.overview: When an unseen animator begins rewriting his hand-drawn world, a lovable cartoon koala must outrun a reality that is literally changing around him in a frantic chase through the collision of art and algorithm.

results.title: Takkuuk
results.overview: Takkuuk is an Inuktitut word meaning to be attentive or to look closely. It is often used to describe the environmental and cultural changes in the Arctic. In the film of the same name, we meet musicians and researchers from the Arctic who explore life, communities, and the challenges they face.  The film is a collaboration between Belfast duo BICEP, visual artist Zak Norman, and filmmaker Charlie Miller. They weave documentary realism, music video aesthetics, and artistic abstraction together with the perspectives of indigenous peoples on the impact of colonialism and industrialization.  The narrative is punctuated by musical vignettes from Inuit and Sami artists (including Greenlandic rapper Tarrak and Sami singer Katarina Barruk), which together form the backbone of BICEP’s score. Meanwhile, specially built cameras capture the Arctic landscapes in surreal, alien colors that reflect a rapidly changing world.

results.title: Shadow of Hope
results.overview: Far from home, a young Burmese man struggles to escape the weight of a brutal and unforgiving military coup, threatening both his nation’s freedom and its very survival. Now, in Australia and unable to return home, he’s doing everything he can to stay connected to his people.

results.title: Frangines
results.overview: Frangines tells the story of Alice's reclusive life in an apartment perpetually shrouded in darkness. A disturbing presence, which she calls "The Dark Thoughts", is preventing her from leaving her mental prison and escaping. But just outside, her sister urges her to return to the light, and thus, to freedom.

results.title: When the Island Floats
results.overview: Mikio, the former manager of a shuttered movie theater, begins tracing his origins when its building is slated for demolition and redevelopment. His high school best friend, Nobuhiro, struggles to face his father’s advancing dementia.  Old things fade away, and new things are born. Every day unfolds as a fleeting moment in a city undergoing constant change.

results.title: The weight of water
results.overview: A guy, who just woke up, has to face the tough reality of water weight.
